name: Content Editing Messages
description: Adds admin-authored, configurable messages (info/warning/error/plain) to node and media add/edit forms, targeted by bundle and optionally by user role, with configurable placement and optional Field Group integration.
project_description:
The Content Editing Message (content_editing_message) module allows you to add multiple messages to content and media forms with multiple displays options. 

 The module has a configuration page in which this functionality can be applied to one (or more) content and media types. Addicionally you can configure:

 
 Title (translatable) 
 Message and format (translatable) 
 Style: info, warning, error or plain 
 Weight: top, bottom or custom 
 
 The configuration page can be found in /admin/config/content/messages .

 This module is compatible with Field Group module. Therefore if installed it will appear an extra option where you can input your field_group machine name (example: group_mytab ).
